prompt: Illustration painted and inked BY HAND on a wood panel — visible wood grain, matte paint, and HAND-DRAWN LINE with slight natural wobble and imperfection. Loose, illustrative, storybook, NOT crisp vector, NOT digital-clean. Simple big flat shapes and generous empty space, high contrast. Palette strictly: pale bone-grey painted ground, FLAT solid black, white line, and ONE accent of glowing BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN. Beings are tiny SOLID BLACK creatures with curled spiral fiddlehead ears. NO human figures. No text, no lettering, no glyphs. A vast landscape at night, hand-drawn: an enormous VOLCANO dominating the frame, its slopes drawn in loose hand-hatched black and white line, a faint BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN glow at its crater and one thin green trickle down one flank. At its foot, very small, a cluster of six tiny cabins with glowing green windows, dwarfed. Rolling hatched foothills, a flat black sky. One tiny black being with spiral ears stands on a rise in the foreground, looking toward the volcano. Enormous scale, tiny village, lots of quiet empty space.
